checkpoints.description: [1/3] Native CPU foundation: audit, CPU detection, packed AVX2 GEMM, thread pool, memory budget

impact_assessment.why: Milestone 0.1 foundation required before any inference work
impact_assessment.benefits: Measured baseline and a kernel pipeline that scales across P/E cores
impact_assessment.risks: Benchmark variance from background memory pressure; GCC-only toolchain
impact_assessment.mitigation: Median/best-of-five reporting; MSVC install tracked as follow-up

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 24/24 tests; GEMM 2048^3 18.2 -> 246.5 GFLOPS (best of 5); llama.cpp baseline pp512 407.6 / tg128 8.73 t/s on 0.5B Q4_K_M
checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 27/27 tests; GEMV decode kernel 35.4 GB/s on 16 threads vs 18.4 on 1; fixed unguarded AVX2 streaming calls
[1/2] Decode path: GEMV kernel, threaded bandwidth measurement, dispatch fix

impact_assessment.why: Token generation is matrix-vector, not matrix-matrix, and had no kernel
impact_assessment.benefits: 2x sustained decode bandwidth; identifies remaining headroom over the baseline
impact_assessment.risks: Thread oversubscription, cache pollution from hints, ISA leakage in diagnostics
impact_assessment.mitigation: Measured thread scaling; prefetch and NTA A/B tested and removed; all kernel entry points feature-selected

checkpoints.description: [1/1] End-to-end decode: GGUF loader, Qwen2 decoder, Q8_0 GEMV, measured against llama.cpp

impact_assessment.why: A speed claim needs an end-to-end measurement on identical weights
impact_assessment.benefits: 2x llama.cpp decode, validated token for token
impact_assessment.risks: Numerics diverge if RoPE layout or biases are wrong; thread oversubscription
impact_assessment.mitigation: Greedy output diffed against llama.cpp; measured thread sweep produced a decode thread policy

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 30/30 tests; decode 30-33 t/s vs llama.cpp 15.2 t/s on identical Q8_0 weights
[1/1] Harden GGUF reader and decoder, test the parser, evaluate integer Q8 kernel

impact_assessment.why: New model-layer code had no tests and several unchecked inputs
impact_assessment.benefits: Malformed files cannot exhaust memory; parser and decoder guards are covered by tests
impact_assessment.risks: Rejecting a valid but unusual file; changing numerics by optimization
impact_assessment.mitigation: Round-trip test built from the format spec; integer kernel measured then reverted to preserve token parity

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 35/35 tests; token parity with llama.cpp restored; no performance change
[1/1] Batched prefill and sampling; close the prompt-processing and greedy-only caveats

impact_assessment.why: Prompt processing was 25x behind llama.cpp because every weight was re-read per token
impact_assessment.benefits: 15x prefill improvement to 60 percent of llama.cpp, with token-identical output across chunk boundaries
impact_assessment.risks: Batching changes numerics if K/V ordering or chunk boundaries are wrong
impact_assessment.mitigation: Greedy output diffed against llama.cpp on a 136-token prompt that crosses two chunk boundaries; batch kernel tested against its scalar reference including the tail path

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; gates 4/4; 43/43 tests; prefill 170.9 t/s, decode 23.4 t/s at 510-token context; token parity intact

impact_assessment.why: Only Q8_0 ran, context was fixed at 2048, and output was ids only
impact_assessment.benefits: Q4_K_M and similar models run correctly; text output; configurable KV
impact_assessment.risks: Wrong dequant math decodes plausible garbage; per-type row strides
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validated against llama.cpp on a Q4_K_M file that mixes four formats; row stride derived from type

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed; 44/44 tests; Q4_K_M matches llama.cpp token for token; context 8192 verified
